We offer our condolences and the support of our prayers to her family and friends at this sad time. Our Advent Journey: You are invited to join us as we gather in this Season of Advent to share and witness the presence of the Spirit in our community. We are plan ning two sessions, taking place on Thursday, 3rd December and Thursday, 10th December at 8:00pm in the Daycare Centre, Clarecastle. All are very welcome. Bereavement Mass : The annual commemoration masses in remembrance of all who died from November last year to the present will be organised by the Parish Bereavement Group will be as follows: Wednesday 25th November Clarecastle Church 7.00pm Friday 27th November Ballyea Church 7.00pm No 7pm Mass - Ballyea Church on Wednesday Clarecastle Christmas Market: Is on in the Abbey Hall on Sat Nov 21st from 4pm to 8.30pm and Sun Nov 22nd from 10am to 3pm. Showcasing 37 different stands. Remember supporting local businesses keeps jobs local! Triduum of Masses: Each year we have a Triduum of Masses in our Parish where people can purchase a card at the Parish Office to include their loved ones in three masses in our parish over the Christmas period. The dates of the masses are 28th, 29th & 30th December, the venue is Clarecastle Church and the time is 11am. To included people in these masses a person makes a donation of €5, which forms part of the proceeds of the Triduum that are given to the Clarecastle Conference of the Society of St Vincent de Paul, and to local charity. Cards are now available at the Parish Office. Clarecastle/Ballyea Community Games AGM: - Tuesday 24th Nov at 8.30pm in Ballyea Community Hall. Everyone is welcome to attend as we are always looking for more volunteers to help out. SVP Christmas Food Appeal: Those who wish to donate a food voucher from Centra/Gala/Tesco/Aldi/Lidl/Dunnes etc. can make that donation by handing them into the Parish Office or Parochial House on or before 15th December . The local SVP Conference will ensure those vouchers are delivered to families and individuals in need within our community in time for these families and individuals to do their Christmas shopping. SVP Pre Addressed Envelopes will also be distributed to households in the parish as always, your concern and generosity throughout the years and especially at this time is greatly appreciated. Abbey Pastoral Area Advent Reconciliation Service : Is commencing on Monday 14th December at 7.30pm, Cathedral of SS Peter & Paul, Ennis. Come and experience the freedom that comes with knowing that we are forgiven. Clarecastle – Ballyea (Clare Abbey)

Calling all young people aged 16 –35 - join us at the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. This is a donation-only event, with free buses availab le across the country and all meals included. Expect inspiring talks and workshops, Mass, music, prayer, and plenty of opportunities to chill out and meet other young Catholics. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome. To register or find out more, visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland. Tipperary Sports Partnership and Technological University of the Shannon (TUS) are delighted to come together to host an inspiring evening featu ring some of Ireland's leading voices in high-performance sport, athlete developments ports psychology and elite performance on Wednesday November 25th at 6pm - 9.30pm at TUS Campus, Thurles. This evening will be hosted by Damian Lawlor of RTE's The Sunday Game, this special event will bring together experts working at the highest levels of sport to share their experiences, insights and practical advice on what it takes to achieve success both on and off the field. Attendees will hear from an outstanding panel of speakers: Sharlene Mawdsley, Jacqui Freyne, Anne-Marie Kennedy, JJ O'Brien. Booking for the event is through
